simple.meaning: a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֹקֵד (H5349) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נֹקֵד (nôqêd) means a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them) First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 3 4.

definitions.short: a spotter (of sheep or cattle), i.e. the owner or tender (who thus marks them)
definitions.full: H5349. noqed נֹקֵד noun masculine sheep-raiser, -dealer, or -tender (Lag NB108 ); — absolute ׳נ only 2Kin 3:4 (of Mesha, king of Moab); plural מִתְּקוֺע בַּנֹּקְדִים אֲשֶׁר Amos 1:1 (of Amos, see Dr; compare 7:14 , where read נוקד for בוקר according to We Now Dr, not GASm, see Bu below); perhaps gloss, compare Bu Kohut Memorial.106 f. Now on the passage
